title: The 1812 Prairie coach house checked against the 18th Street photographs
items: Nothing you can see changes in the town. Four old pictures looking south down Prairie Avenue from 18th Street were listed as pictures of the coach house behind 1812 Prairie.
They are one photograph, and the coach house is not in it. It stands on the alley, past the right edge of the picture and behind the Glessner house.
Those pictures now count toward the 1812 house itself, whose front is in them, far down the row.
